description: Label the current workspace state with a user-supplied name. The label is mirrored into workspace.meta.tags so UIs can render a named-revision history. Tagging the same label twice is idempotent — no error, no duplicate entry.

name.description: Checkpoint label, e.g. "before EV layer added" or "v1.0".

rationale.description: Optional short label (≤300 chars) for the map edit history, e.g. "add wildfire layer". Omit it to send nothing beyond the tool arguments.

name: tag
title: Save a named checkpoint (direct)
